scope: Three independently designed p5-only operations, six original editable design studies and six gallery/Studio entries; no Java/py5/Android implementation or surveyed-original recreation credit.

checks.core: Analytical shared fixtures and distinguishing ownership, geometry, invalid-input, overflow, work-budget and rounding cases; timed tiny/study/stress workloads.
checks.native: Final native report: six gallery baselines, structural edits, palette transfers, exact reload; six standalone examples with structural/style controls, exact reset/reload and save without redraw.
checks.web: 49 web tests passed, including old-v3 app/mixed-source migration, all-six default/max control command checks; typecheck passed.
checks.production: Isolated p5-only checkout built with Next16.3.4; all six production gallery image sets exactly match reviewed development images. Concurrent Studio redesign preserved separately.
checks.package: Fresh local npm tarball offline-installed and all installed files compared; exports resolve through installed package.
checks.visual: Root inspected gallery and standalone baseline/edit contact sheets for all six; final native image hashes exactly equal reviewed preliminary image hashes. Palette-only geometry preservation also checked at command level.

visual_findings.cell-mosaic: More cells create visibly finer irregular tile regions; facets remain within the convex tiles.
visual_findings.cell-echoes: More nested outlines increase detail while preserving the cell boundaries.
visual_findings.stitched-paths: Increasing sample count increases thread density along unchanged waves; native wave-count edit changes curvature.
visual_findings.orbit-beads: Increasing bead count preserves lobed outlines; native lobe edit produces a distinct five-lobed form.
visual_findings.contour-terrain: Higher field frequency produces visibly smaller terrain features; native level edit adds intermediate contours.
visual_findings.contour-blobs: Higher threshold shrinks contour extent; wider native hills create larger merged level sets.

limitations: Voronoi uses binary64 clipping without exact robust predicates.
Contours are independent cell segments; no contour stitching or filled region output.
Polyline sampling retains rounded duplicate samples where binary64 cannot distinguish distances.
Only selected p5 Canvas2D studies are visually accepted; technique attestation remains unvalidated and no corpus-recreation count is added.
